findings.message: Version tag "3.1" moved to zeebe:versionTag.
findings.suggestion: zeebe:versionTag

findings.message: Camunda 8 has no per-process history time to live (was "180").
findings.suggestion: Configure data retention for the cluster (Operate, Tasklist and Optimize archiving).

findings.message: Execution listener on "start" (class "com.acme.orders.AuditListener") runs Java or script code in the engine.
findings.suggestion: Implement it as a job worker and declare it with zeebe:executionListeners (eventType="start", type="<job type>").

findings.message: Camunda 8 does not record the starting user in a variable.
findings.suggestion: Pass the user as a variable when creating the instance.

findings.message: Implemented as a Camunda user task (zeebe:userTask).
findings.suggestion: zeebe:userTask

findings.message: assignee became zeebe:assignmentDefinition assignee="=starter".
findings.suggestion: zeebe:assignmentDefinition

findings.message: candidateGroups became zeebe:assignmentDefinition candidateGroups="sales,management".
findings.suggestion: zeebe:assignmentDefinition

findings.message: dueDate became zeebe:taskSchedule dueDate="=reviewDueDate".
findings.suggestion: zeebe:taskSchedule — the value must be an ISO 8601 date-time.

findings.message: Priority 80 became zeebe:priorityDefinition.
findings.suggestion: zeebe:priorityDefinition

findings.message: Camunda Form "review-order" linked with zeebe:formDefinition formId.
findings.suggestion: Deploy the .form file with the process; Camunda 7 and 8 share the form-js schema.

findings.message: Task listener on "create" (class "com.acme.orders.NotifyReviewer") runs code in the engine.
findings.suggestion: Implement it as a job worker and declare it with zeebe:taskListeners (eventType="creating").

findings.message: Dropped: Camunda 8 has no asynchronous continuations. The engine commits after every step and every job-based task is already a wait state, so there is no transaction boundary to place and no job executor job to prioritise.
findings.suggestion: Nothing to model. A failure no longer rolls back to the last async boundary: a job failure retries the job, and an expression failure raises an incident on the element.

findings.message: External task topic "charge-payment" became job type "charge-payment".
findings.suggestion: zeebe:taskDefinition type — point the external task worker at the Camunda 8 job API with the same type.

findings.message: 3 input/output parameters moved to zeebe:ioMapping, JUEL translated to FEEL.
findings.suggestion: zeebe:ioMapping

findings.message: Retry count 5 moved to zeebe:taskDefinition retries.
findings.suggestion: zeebe:taskDefinition retries

findings.message: The retry interval (PT5M) is not part of the Camunda 8 model.
findings.suggestion: Pass it as the retry back-off when the worker fails the job (fail-job retryBackOff).

findings.message: Camunda 7 correlates message "PaymentConfirmed" by API call (business key, process variables or instance id); the model names no key, and Camunda 8 requires one.
findings.suggestion: Add <zeebe:subscription correlationKey="=…"/> to message "Message_PaymentConfirmed", naming the variable publishers correlate on.

findings.message: Decision "shipping-cost" → zeebe:calledDecision, result in "shippingCost".
findings.suggestion: zeebe:calledDecision

findings.message: Result mapper "singleEntry" matches Camunda 8, which stores a single output value as-is.
findings.suggestion: Nothing to model.

findings.message: Calls "invoice-process" through zeebe:calledElement.
findings.suggestion: zeebe:calledElement

findings.message: Variable passing kept as in Camunda 7: only mapped parent variables in, only mapped child variables out.
findings.suggestion: zeebe:calledElement propagateAllParentVariables / propagateAllChildVariables and zeebe:ioMapping

findings.message: Java delegate class "com.acme.orders.ShipOrderDelegate" runs inside the Camunda 7 engine; Camunda 8 runs no user code in the engine.
findings.suggestion: Implement a job worker for type "shipOrderDelegate" (written as zeebe:taskDefinition type; the original is kept as the "class" task header, which the Camunda 7 adapter pattern can dispatch on).

findings.message: Timer expression "${deliveryWindow}" became "=deliveryWindow".
findings.suggestion: FEEL timer expression

findings.message: Script was not converted: groovy scripts do not run in Camunda 8.
findings.suggestion: Rewrite it as a FEEL expression in zeebe:script (expression, resultVariable), or implement it as a job worker with zeebe:taskDefinition.

findings.message: Delegate expression "${notificationService}" runs inside the Camunda 7 engine; Camunda 8 runs no user code in the engine.
findings.suggestion: Implement a job worker for type "notificationService" (written as zeebe:taskDefinition type; the original is kept as the "delegateExpression" task header, which the Camunda 7 adapter pattern can dispatch on).

findings.message: Expression "${escalation.raise(execution)}" runs inside the Camunda 7 engine; Camunda 8 runs no user code in the engine.
findings.suggestion: Implement a job worker for type "Task_escalate" (written as zeebe:taskDefinition type; the original is kept as the "expression" task header, which the Camunda 7 adapter pattern can dispatch on).

findings.message: Condition "${approved && order.total <= 1000}" became "=approved and order.total <= 1000".
findings.suggestion: FEEL condition

findings.message: Condition "${approved and order.customer.vip eq true}" became "=approved and order.customer.vip = true".
findings.suggestion: FEEL condition

findings.message: Execution platform set to Camunda Cloud 8.10.0 (was Camunda Platform).
findings.suggestion: Camunda Modeler opens the file as a Camunda 8 diagram.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" xmlns:camunda="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/bpmn" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:modeler="http://camunda.org/schema/modeler/1.0" xmlns:zeebe="http://camunda.org/schema/zeebe/1.0" id="Definitions_1k3v0qa" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn" exporter="Camunda Modeler" exporterVersion="5.28.0" modeler:executionPlatform="Camunda Cloud" modeler:executionPlatformVersion="8.10.0">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentConfirmed" name="PaymentConfirmed"/>
  <bpmn:process id="order-fulfillment" camunda:historyTimeToLive="180" name="Order fulfillment" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:extensionElements>
      <camunda:executionListener class="com.acme.orders.AuditListener" event="start"/>
      <zeebe:versionTag value="3.1"/>
    </bpmn:extensionElements>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_order" camunda:initiator="starter" name="Order received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_toReview</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_review" name="Review order">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <camunda:taskListener class="com.acme.orders.NotifyReviewer" event="create"/>
        <zeebe:userTask/>
        <zeebe:assignmentDefinition assignee="=starter" candidateGroups="sales,management"/>
        <zeebe:taskSchedule dueDate="=reviewDueDate"/>
        <zeebe:priorityDefinition priority="80"/>
        <zeebe:formDefinition formId="review-order" bindingType="deployment"/>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_toReview</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_toApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_approved" name="Approved?" default="Flow_rejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_toApproved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_approved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_rejected</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_vip</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_charge" name="Charge payment">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <zeebe:taskDefinition type="charge-payment" retries="5"/>
        <zeebe:ioMapping>
          <zeebe:input source="=order.total" target="amount"/>
          <zeebe:input source="="EUR"" target="currency"/>
          <zeebe:output source="=transactionId" target="paymentId"/>
        </zeebe:ioMapping>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_vip</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_toConfirm</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_awaitPayment" name="Await payment confirmation" messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_toConfirm</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_toShippingCost</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:businessRuleTask id="Task_shippingCost" name="Determine shipping cost">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <zeebe:calledDecision decisionId="shipping-cost" resultVariable="shippingCost"/>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_toShippingCost</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_toInvoice</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:businessRuleTask>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="Task_invoice" calledElement="invoice-process" name="Create invoice">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <zeebe:calledElement processId="invoice-process" bindingType="deployment" propagateAllParentVariables="false"/>
        <zeebe:ioMapping>
          <zeebe:input source="=orderId" target="orderId"/>
          <zeebe:input source="=order.total + shippingCost" target="invoiceTotal"/>
          <zeebe:output source="=invoiceId" target="invoiceId"/>
        </zeebe:ioMapping>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_toInvoice</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_toShip</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ship" name="Ship order">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <zeebe:taskDefinition type="shipOrderDelegate"/>
        <zeebe:taskHeaders>
          <zeebe:header key="class" value="com.acme.orders.ShipOrderDelegate"/>
        </zeebe:taskHeaders>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_toShip</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_toWait</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Timer_wait" name="Wait for delivery window">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_toWait</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_toSummary</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_wait">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">=deliveryWindow</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:scriptTask id="Task_summary" scriptFormat="groovy" camunda:resultVariable="summary" name="Build summary">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_toSummary</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_toDone</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:script>"Order ${orderId} shipped at ${new Date()}"</bpmn:script>
    </bpmn:scriptTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_done" name="Order fulfilled">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_toDone</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_notify" name="Notify customer">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <zeebe:taskDefinition type="notificationService"/>
        <zeebe:taskHeaders>
          <zeebe:header key="delegateExpression" value="${notificationService}"/>
        </zeebe:taskHeaders>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_rejected</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_toRejectedEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_rejected" name="Order rejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_toRejectedEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Timer_reviewOverdue" name="3 days" attachedToRef="Task_review" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_toEscalate</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_overdue">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P3D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_escalate" name="Escalate review">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <zeebe:taskDefinition type="Task_escalate"/>
        <zeebe:taskHeaders>
          <zeebe:header key="expression" value="${escalation.raise(execution)}"/>
          <zeebe:header key="resultVariable" value="escalationId"/>
        </zeebe:taskHeaders>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_toEscalate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_toEscalated</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_escalated" name="Escalated">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_toEscalated</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_toReview" sourceRef="StartEvent_order" targetRef="Task_review"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_toApproved" sourceRef="Task_review" targetRef="Gateway_approved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_approved" sourceRef="Gateway_approved" targetRef="Task_charge" name="yes">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">=approved and order.total <= 1000</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_vip" sourceRef="Gateway_approved" targetRef="Task_charge" name="vip">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">=approved and order.customer.vip = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_approved" targetRef="Task_notify" name="no"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_toConfirm" sourceRef="Task_charge" targetRef="Task_awaitPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_toShippingCost" sourceRef="Task_awaitPayment" targetRef="Task_shippingCost"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_toInvoice" sourceRef="Task_shippingCost" targetRef="Task_invoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_toShip" sourceRef="Task_invoice" targetRef="Task_ship"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_toWait" sourceRef="Task_ship" targetRef="Timer_wait"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_toSummary" sourceRef="Timer_wait" targetRef="Task_summary"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_toDone" sourceRef="Task_summary" targetRef="EndEvent_done"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_toRejectedEnd" sourceRef="Task_notify" targetRef="EndEvent_rejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_toEscalate" sourceRef="Timer_reviewOverdue" targetRef="Task_escalate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_toEscalated" sourceRef="Task_escalate" targetRef="EndEvent_escalated"/>
